arguments:
set -eu
printf 'USER='; id -un
printf 'CWD='; pwd
printf 'DEPLOYED_SHA='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'TRACKED_WORKTREE='; if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]; then echo clean; else echo dirty; fi
printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'SERVICE='; systemctl is-active lowcost-europa.service || true
printf 'READY_LOCAL='; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8001/health/ready/ || true; echo
printf 'VENV='; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python --version; else echo absent; fi
printf 'BACKUP_FILE='; find /var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'lowcost-europa-*.dump' -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n 1 || true
printf 'DISK_FREE='; df -P . | tail -n 1 | awk '{print $4}'
